styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, the National Theatre and Barrio Escalante's cafés.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Cloud-forest day trips, coffee farms and city parks.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Markets, sodas and the Escalante restaurant strip.

stays.why: Walk to the National Theatre, museums and markets. Busy and basic by night; keep valuables close.
Quiet old quarter of colonial houses and small hotels, a short walk from downtown sights.
Best food and nightlife strip; leafy streets and boutique hotels. Good for evenings.
University district near the museums and San Pedro Mall; cheaper and local, a short bus or taxi from the centre.

food: Eat at a soda (small local diner): casado (rice, beans, plantain, meat) is a filling lunch, often ₡3,000–6,000.
Mercado Central downtown: fruit, coffee and cheap stalls; go before midday.
Barrio Escalante has the widest restaurant choice; book on weekend evenings.
Try gallo pinto at breakfast and fresh tropical fruit; coffee is a local point of pride.
Tap water is generally safe in the city; check on the day outside it.
more_time: Add a day trip to a coffee farm or Poás or Irazú volcano; tours leave early, check on the day for closures.
Swap a city afternoon for the Museo del Oro and Museo Nacional, both downtown.
Take a bus to Cartago or the Orosi Valley for colonial history and cooler air.

recommend.why: Two nights covers downtown sights, Escalante's food and one volcano or coffee-farm day trip.

month_notes: Dry and mild: highs 25°C, about 8 rain days. Great for walking downtown.
Driest month, about 6 rain days. Book volcano trips early.
Still fairly dry, 8 rain days; warm days around 27°C.
Rain builds, about 17 rain days. Carry a rain jacket.
Wet season: 27 rain days. Mornings are usually clearer; plan indoors for afternoons.
Very wet, 28 rain days. Expect afternoon downpours.
Wet but a small break, 24 rain days.
Wet again, 27 rain days; pack waterproofs.
Wettest month, 29 rain days. Keep plans flexible.
Rain eases, 25 rain days; still carry an umbrella.
Drier, 13 rain days. Good month for day trips.
Dry season returns, about 8 rain days. Comfortable highs near 24°C.

climate_guide.summary: Tropical highland city: mild all year, with a dry season roughly December to March and heavy afternoon rain from May to October.

items.title: Best time: December to March
items.text: Highs 24–27°C, lows near 16°C and few rain days. Best for walking and day trips.

items.title: Wet season May to October
items.text: 24–29 rain days a month. Rain usually comes in the afternoon; do outdoor plans in the morning.

items.title: Mild temperatures all year
items.text: Highs stay 24–27°C and lows 16–17°C. Bring a light layer for evenings.

items.title: Pack rain gear
items.text: A compact umbrella and a light waterproof jacket help from May to November.

items.title: Cloud and mist on hills
items.text: Volcano and cloud-forest trips can be cloudy or closed; check on the day.

items.title: Sun at altitude
items.text: The city sits high; sun is strong even on cloudy days. Use sunscreen.

transit.best: Uber, DiDi or a taxi for most trips; cheap city buses if you're saving money.

modes.text: No metro or tram. Don't plan around rail.
City buses cost about ₡500 per ride, no transfers or day passes. Use the Moovit app for routes and schedules.
Taxis should use a meter but often don't; agree the price first. Uber and DiDi work well, though Uber is technically illegal.
Driving is slow and confusing. Only worth it for out-of-town trips.
Fine downtown by day. Bike lanes are limited.
